scope: Static higher-tier art previews; no runtime or Unity integration.

prompts.archWidePrompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: higher-tier poker player identity namecard background in an existing game.
Input image 1 is the approved tier-one namecard EDIT TARGET: preserve its face-on full-bleed UI geometry, thin rectangular rim with subtly rounded corners, dark contract-paper material, faint right-side heraldic impression and bottom iron chain. Input image 2 is the corresponding contract inventory icon, used ONLY for matching cartoon rendering and tier-specific demonic motifs. Do not paste the inventory icon onto the card.
The user loves the first-tier design and explicitly wants higher tiers with progressively REDDER, FRESH SCARLET color and increasingly obvious hellfire. Keep the family unmistakable, with clean black outlines and simple cel shading. Red is the leading color; gold is only trim. No photo-realism.
Output exactly 2048x768, 8:3, single fully opaque flat UI artwork edge-to-edge. No surrounding background, perspective or presentation board.
Geometry: decoration band is outer 64 px, target 48 px. ALL horns, crowns, chains, flames, seals, highlights and strong glow must lie within 64 pixels of their nearest canvas edge. Central rectangle x=64..1984, y=64..704 contains ONLY a quiet low-contrast colored parchment background and very faint matte heraldry. UI safe rectangle x=96..1952, y=96..672 stays spacious for white names and gold balances. Keep horns low and swept horizontally along the TOP BORDER, at most 42px high. Any top center crest at most 44px tall, embedded in top rim, never a large medallion. Bottom chain at most 24px tall in lowest 32px. Wax mark merely a tiny flat dab <=24px tall integrated in bottom rim. Flames can curl a long distance ALONG borders but reach inward only 48-56px. Make stronger fire by brighter scarlet hue, more edge coverage and clearer flame silhouettes, NOT wider border intrusion.
Use visible colored dark midtones, broad soft parchment folds, fully opaque background, no black hole. No text, letters, numbers, writing, signatures, names, prices, gameplay symbols, labels, guides, watermark, checkerboard, skulls, figures, large jewelry, quill or opaque objects in the center. No bright glowing eyes or blazing central sigil.
TIER TWO — Archdevil, working title 深狱领主 (do NOT paint title).
Compared with tier one, replace the brown oxblood cast with distinctly more saturated deep CRIMSON parchment, dark blood-red broad folds and diffuse red illumination across the lower sides. Quiet center around #500e15 to #65121b; strong red chroma rather than brown. Keep faint matte FOUR-HORN devil heraldry impressed on the right, only a few shades darker than paper.
Two PAIRS of miniature red-black horn flourishes: a paired horn motif at each top corner. Mount them horizontally along the rim. No crown. Thin black iron/gold frame now has a noticeable ruby-red enamel line. One slender black iron chain with clear crimson reflections hugs bottom. Distinct cel-shaded SCARLET flames curl upward ALONG both side rails and flicker sideways along roughly half the lower border, with small vermilion inner shapes. They should be clearly more numerous and more red than the tier-one's sparse flames, but leave dark breaks along borders. Fire remains crisp and red, not yellow-dominant. Retain miniature bottom-right flat red wax mark. An unmistakable stronger intermediate tier, leave full perimeter inferno and royal crown for tier three.

prompts.satanFirePrompt:

Keep this exact 2048x768 Satan namecard: preserve the vivid red parchment background, subtle right trident/crown heraldry, miniature horns, gold rim and crown, thin bottom chain, all composition. Change ONLY the flame ribbon. prompts.archCompactPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Create an independently recomposed 4:3 compact edition of the supplied higher-tier namecard, keeping its exact theme and color strength.
Image 1 is the matching higher-tier WIDE art reference. Image 2 is the approved tier-one COMPACT edit target, used for exact compact aspect ratio and spacious thin-frame UI geometry.
Output exact 4:3, preferably 1448x1086 (or 1024x768). Single fully opaque flat UI card filling canvas, no outside margins or perspective. Do not crop or squeeze wide art. Recompose the faint heraldry in the upper/middle-right of the compact field with generous quiet center-left. Preserve image 1's parchment texture, red color, cel shaded clean cartoon outlines, tier-specific horn/crown details, bottom iron chain and tiny wax mark. Do not reduce saturation to tier-one brown.
Critical geometry based on standard 1024x768: all bright fire, crown, horns and ornaments must fit in outer 64px band, preferably 48px. If generating 1448x1086 multiply these distances by 1.414: outer ornament limit 90px, preferred 68px; content safety inset 136px. Corner details obey nearest-edge rule too. Flames curl along borders, not into center. Miniature horns and optional crown hug top edge, NO giant medallions. Keep the background completely opaque, colored and low contrast for UI added later. Only soft faint matte insignia inside safety area.
No text, signature, letters, numbers, prices, gameplay badges, names, guides, placeholders, watermark, quill, skull, character or black empty interior. This is tier TWO Archdevil / 深狱领主. Exactly two small swept red horns at each upper corner (four total), no crown. Background deep crimson matching image 1, clearly redder than image 2. Faint four-horn demonic seal on right. Obvious narrow red flame tongues climb both side rails and parts of bottom, with dark breaks; thin red enamel top rim and black/red-reflected bottom chain. Leave full four-sided fire and brighter scarlet for Satan.
